requirements.acceptance: Formatting, strict Clippy, ordinary tests including process-kill recovery and release compilation from the same source.
Every advertised exact-file/encoding/task profile passes independent numerical, tokenizer, CLI/API/SSE and managed-history checks.
Reviewed sustained mixed-task memory, cancellation, backpressure, fairness, restart and exhaustion evidence with frozen acceptance thresholds.
Verified native archive, complete legal payload, empty-PATH startup and actual offline model inference from extracted executables.
Sanitizer/coverage campaigns, hostile-input and fault coverage, reviewed security findings and sustained campaign adequacy.
Current RustSec workspace/fuzz audits with database revision; all vulnerability, maintenance and license findings resolved or explicitly reviewed.
Clean stable release revision, supported OS baselines, trusted signing/provenance and independent numerical/security/operational review.

notes: This narrower CPU scope does not waive any mandatory full-release capability or GPU/platform/model requirement.
Configuration, candidate packaging and bounded local campaigns alone cannot qualify production.
